rationale.conceptual: Standard method (REBO potential, geometry optimization, Voigt–Reuss–Hill averaging) with minor variation (applying to hexagonal diamond). No novel algorithm or deep mathematical derivation; the calculations follow well-documented procedures used in many prior works.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of running GULP at several pressures and post-processing with straightforward Python scripts. Only one external tool (GULP) is needed, and the solve script shows the outputs can be generated by a single Python file. Few stages, no complex orchestration.

The execution pipeline is a simple script invoking GULP and post-processing the results, with only a few sequential steps.
